question: Should phone-code input remain a WhatsApp-owned interactive login choice, or should OpenClaw commit to a shared `ChannelAuthAdapter.phoneNumber` and global `channels login --phone-number` contract for future channels?
rationale: The repository policy keeps owner-specific authentication behavior in the owner plugin and treats plugin/channel API additions as compatibility-sensitive; this is a durable product-contract choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Keep it WhatsApp-owned
options.body: Remove the generic CLI and adapter input, and implement the phone-code choice inside the existing WhatsApp login flow while preserving QR as the default.

options.title: Sponsor a shared channel-auth API
options.body: Retain the generic input only after documenting which non-WhatsApp channels need it, its compatibility contract, and the intended user experience.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Wait for the canonical API decision and physical-device validation before continuing either competing implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep it WhatsApp-owned
recommendation.body: Remove the generic CLI and adapter input, and implement the phone-code choice inside the existing WhatsApp login flow while preserving QR as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: The active maintainer-authored alternative already embodies the plugin-local design and is the clearest available routing candidate.
